usedFor: AgentMail gives AI agents their own inboxes, and Zoom runs the webinars. A “New Email Received” in an AgentMail inbox can run “Register Attendee for Webinar” in Zoom, so a reply to an invitation becomes a registration.

bestTemplate.name: “New Email Received” in AgentMail, then “Register Attendee for Webinar” in Zoom
bestTemplate.why: Inbound mail is the one AgentMail trigger where a person is asking to join something. “Register Attendee for Webinar” adds them to the webinar.

watchOut: The AgentMail bounce and spam complaint triggers run this same Zoom action, so only “New Email Received” fits. The bounce and spam ones would register people who never asked.
